verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Brave Search API as a keyword/index-based crawler service (crawls and indexes billions of pages, supports site:, quotes, exclusion operators) plus AI-generated summaries/answers layered on top of search results — nothing describes vector/embedding-based semantic retrieval that surfaces results a keyword engine would miss. AI Answers/LLM Context endpoints ground answers on existing keyword search results rather than performing meaning-based retrieval.
